title: Monomorphisms in a pre-triangulated category split
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a pre-triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category]. If $f:A\to B$ is a monomorphism, then there exists $r:B\to A$ such that $r\circ f=\mathrm{id}_A$. Here monomorphism means that for every object $T$ and $a,b:T\to A$, the equality $f\circ a=f\circ b$ implies $a=b$.
